camel_example: aliyun ons OnsTraceQueryByMsgKey --region cn-hangzhou --EndTime 1570968000000 --MsgKey ORDERID_100 --BeginTime 1570852800000 --Topic test
description_en: Creates a trace query task based on a topic name and a message key and returns the ID of the query task. You must then call the OnsTraceGetResult operation and pass the returned query task ID to retrieve the detailed results of the message trace
description_zh: 通过传入Topic名称和Message Key创建轨迹查询任务，得到该查询任务的ID。您需要再调用OnsTraceGetResult接口，传入返回的查询任务ID，获取消息轨迹的详细结果
kebab_example: aliyun ons ons-trace-query-by-msg-key --topic test --msg-key ORDERID_100 --begin-time 1570852800000 --end-time 1570968000000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: OnsTraceQueryByMsgKey

parameters.help_en: The topic of the message to query
parameters.name: topic

parameters.help_en: The message key of the message to query
parameters.name: msg_key

parameters.help_en: The beginning of the time range to query. The value is a UNIX timestamp in milliseconds
parameters.help_zh: 查询的时间范围的起始时间戳，单位：毫秒
parameters.name: begin_time

parameters.help_en: The end of the time range to query. The value is a UNIX timestamp in milliseconds
parameters.help_zh: 查询的时间范围的结束时间戳，单位：毫秒
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en: The ID of the instance to which the topic of the message belongs
parameters.help_zh: 需查询的消息的Topic所对应的实例ID
parameters.name: instance_id

QueryId.description_en: The ID of the query task. You must call the [OnsTraceGetResult]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/59832.html） operation with this task ID to obtain the detailed results
QueryId.description_zh: 该查询任务的ID。您需要根据该任务ID再调用[OnsTraceGetResult]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/59832.html）接口获取详细结果

RequestId.description_en: The ID of the request. This is a common parameter. Each request has a unique ID that you can use to troubleshoot and locate issues
RequestId.description_zh: 公共参数，每个请求的ID都是唯一的，可用于排查和定位问题
